adaptation.coverage: belief-only optimistic unknown area at 0.8m sampling plus observed frontiers; not 3D surface quality
adaptation.gain_thresholds: one 2D sample; positive gain only; 3D point counts are not copied
adaptation.global_path: planar 16m cells, informative representatives, graph-distance OR-Tools TSP; continue on local completion
adaptation.lookahead: 8m along selected path; execute from robot index, not boundary index
adaptation.randomness: upstream randomized greedy sampling; experiment-seeded mt19937
adaptation.viewpoints: existing planar graph revalidated in both directions against current belief; local reachable 80m square

adapter_metadata.model_name: TARE-Local official core (2D coverage and scheduling adapter)
adapter_metadata.recovery_policy: native planner behavior; no Mamba recovery overlay
